system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: ksweather_get_weather_forecast and ksweather_get_weather_alerts.. my time_range is dummy_time_range_8388, my location is dummy_location_5165.

function.name: ksweather_get_weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves weather forecast for a location for up to 10 days. Returns predicted temperature, rainfall, humidity, and wind. Forecasts are reliable up to 7-10 days only. PUBLIC tool — no authentication needed. Does NOT provide current conditions — use ksweather_get_current_weather. Fails if location is invalid or forecast data is unavailable. Forecasts are predictive and may change.

function.name: ksweather_get_weather_alerts
function.description: Fetches active extreme weather alerts (storms, heavy rainfall, heatwaves, cold waves, frost) for a location. PUBLIC tool. Returns alert severity, type, and validity period. Does NOT provide agricultural advisory — use ksweather_get_weather_advisory. Fails if location is invalid. Returns empty if no active alerts exist. Old/expired alerts are NOT returned.
